items.item_text: Clinical Nurse Specialist (CNS) licensed by the State Board of Registered Nursing.
Neonatal Intensive Care Nursing Certification from a nationally recognized accrediting organization.
Neonatal Resuscitation Program Instructor Certification within 90 days.
Master’s and/or Doctoral degree in Nursing.
Minimum of two (2) years of clinical nursing experience, with at least one (1) year in a facility with a NICU equivalent to a Regional, Community, or Intermediate CCS NICU.
Clinical Leadership: Collaborate with the leadership team to plan, implement, and evaluate high-quality nursing care across the NICU.
Staff Development: Oversee competency-based orientation and provide ongoing coaching, teaching, and professional development for unit personnel.
Strategic Planning: Assist in establishing departmental goals, strategic initiatives, and outcome measures to drive continuous improvement.
Education Delivery: Identify clinical knowledge gaps and develop/facilitate comprehensive educational programs and courses for staff.
Policy & Protocol: Partner with leadership to develop and refine clinical policies, procedures, and evidence-based performance standards.
Continuity of Care: Facilitate multidisciplinary collaboration between medical teams and patient families to optimize outcomes and resource utilization.
